camera.note: gain 0.56; offset map = loc-masked median - smooth of this movie (masked by baseline smlm.hdf5, frames 0-20000); read noise = 0.5 nM map shifted by the sensor ROI offset (dy 15, dx -6; 83% covered) + high-passed own estimate elsewhere

psf3d.note: image-plane blur covariance px^2 [sxx, syy, sxy] (VectorialPSF.blur); psf_dipole_M_angle = emission-dipole tensor per pattern angle (frame % 6 // 3), M_a = (1 - gamma) diag((1 - zeta)/2, (1 - zeta)/2, zeta) + gamma e_a e_a^T; see docs/PSF_POLARIZATION.md; THIS FILE = the average of the two axis PSFs (pattern-free consumers)
